name: x2611_12360_thm1_3
original:
For every positive integer $n$ and every $\alpha>0$ satisfying

 $\alpha^{2}\notin\left\{\frac{1}{4},\frac{1}{9},\frac{2}{15},\frac{3}{4}\right\},$ 

we have

 $\mathbb{E}^{n}\not\to(\ell_{3},\alpha\ell_{21}).$
